item.title: Ajit Pawar Death: Viral Photo Misidentifies Pilot Killed In Baramati Plane Crash
item.description: The viral photograph being shared online does not show the pilot who was in charge of the charter plane that crashed in Baramati, killing all on board, including Ajit Pawar. The pilot of that flight was Captain Sumit Kapoor, and the verified photographs of him differ from the man shown in the viral image.

item.title: Epstein Files: Viral Images of Donald Trump and Bill Clinton in Compromising Positions Are AI-Generated
item.description: Both viral images allegedly showing Donald Trump and Bill Clinton in compromising positions are digitally fabricated and not part of any verified Epstein file release.

item.title: Indian Media Outlets Wrongly Report That Ex-Indonesian President Visited Tirumala Temple
item.description: The claim that former Indonesian President Joko Widodo visited the Tirumala Tirupati Temple is false. Both his office and the Indonesian Embassy have denied the visit, and visual evidence shows the man in the viral video is someone else. Multiple media outlets appear to have relied on unverified information, contributing to the spread of the incorrect report.
